svg.text: Bolt clearance holes (16 total, 8 per flange
Bolt hole edge chamfer, both sides
1. INTERPRET PER ASME Y14.5-2018. UNITS mm. UNLESS NOTED: X.X ±0.2, X.XX ±0.05.
2. BREAK ALL EDGES 0.2-0.4 UNLESS NOTED. NO BURRS.
3. VENT ALL BLIND HOLES IN VACUUM-EXPOSED PARTS PER DR-6 (spec/00).
4. PROVENANCE: EVERY DIMENSION TRACES PER THE SIDECAR PROVENANCE FILE OF THIS DRAWING (AIEF).
5. CERAMIC: COMPRESSION ONLY, NO THREADS (spec/00 §9 CERAMIC JOINT RULE).
6. TOP FACE LAPPED AT ASSEMBLY FROM AS-BUILT STACK DATA (spec/00 §5.3, DR-3).
7. REGISTER REBATE PER SR-D16 REGISTER — DEGENERATE ROWS TABULATED, CANDIDATE ECR-Q (CARRIED).
8. EDGE BREAK ALL CERAMIC EDGES 0.3–0.5 × 45° (CERAMIC EDGE-BREAK STANDARD NOTE).
CHUCK SUPPORT RING SEWCP-400 — Geometry (as-supplied / as-lapped)
